id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataItem.description:
Read-only. The wrapped data object for the current row.
Property `obj` is an object containing data for the current row.

children.description: Read-only. The elements to render as children of this element.

columnProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the column to which the cell belongs.

gridProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the grid to which the cell belongs.

valueToIndicatorMapping.description: Mapping from value of the field to the desired status indicator.

expressionToIndicator.description:
Array of JavaScript expressions with the desired status indicator.
Configures the indicator shown if the expression holds true.
The field will overwrite the indicator of #valueToIndicatorMapping.
In addition, the array would give priority to the earlier expressions.

expressionToTooltip.description:
Array of JavaScript expressions with the desired tooltip.
Configures the tooltip shown if the expression holds true.
If this field is empty or no expression is accomplished a
tooltip won't appear.

unit.description: Unit for the cell value. Supports translation.

formattedUnderscore.description: Whether the field value should be formatted by replacing underscores with spaces.

hideText.description: Whether the field value should be hidden.

redirectLink.description: The URL to which the {@link User} is redirected upon clicking the cell value.

pathToIconConfig.description: Path to the font-awesome icon name and color.

title:
Displays an icon and the value for the path `UiSdlReliabilityIconCell#fieldPath`.

{@link UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting}s that this component respects:

  1. [redirectLink](UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#redirectLink) - Requires the use of #redirectLink on this type.
  2. [subInformation](UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#subInformation) - Not including the format spec.
  3. [actionSuffix](UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#actionSuffix)

All other fields that change the specific cell are not officially supported.

When clicked, this cell will always trigger {@link UiSdlDataGrid#clickRowAction}.
name: UiSdlReliabilityIconCell
